title: 18154 - 18154/P1746/005958
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
symptoms: Malfunction Indicator Light (MIL) ON or (PRND - blinking or solid)
commonCauses: Low voltage at Transmission Control Module - J743
Internal concerns with Transmission Control Module - J743
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) for Transmission Control Module - J743
Repair/Değiştirin / Yenileyin: Transmission Control Module - J743
technicalNotes:
